prompt: Draw a clean black-outlined simple house with a rectangular house body viewed slightly in perspective, a large sloping gable roof with vertical roof panel seams, a rectangular chimney rising from the roof, two square four-pane windows on the front wall, and a simple narrow arched door on the left side wall.

steps.name: house_front_wall
steps.description: Draw the large front wall beneath the right roof slope.

elements.placement: Front rectangular wall shown slightly in perspective, with the roof forming its upper boundary.

steps.name: left_gable_wall
steps.description: Draw the triangular left gable and the left side wall of the house.

elements.placement: Left side wall beginning beneath the triangular gable and joining the front wall at the lower-right corner.
Diagonal edge from the roof peak to the upper-left corner of the front wall.

steps.name: main_roof_outline
steps.description: Draw the large sloping roof plane extending from the left roof ridge to the right eave.

elements.placement: Long slightly rising roof ridge from the left gable peak toward the upper-right corner.
Outer right edge of the roof descending from the upper-right roof corner to the eave.
Long lower roof edge running from the front-left roof corner to the far-right eave.
Left boundary of the main roof plane.

steps.name: left_roof_overhang
steps.description: Draw the narrow roof overhang visible along the left gable side.

elements.placement: Outer diagonal roof edge running from the gable peak downward-left.
Short lower edge giving the roof overhang visible thickness.
Inner diagonal edge returning toward the gable peak.

steps.name: roof_panel_seams
steps.description: Divide the main roof plane into long panels using evenly spaced diagonal seam lines running from the ridge toward the lower eave.

elements.placement: Five approximately parallel diagonal seams following the perspective of the roof.

steps.name: roof_eave_emphasis
steps.description: Add the slightly extended front eave visible beyond the front wall.

elements.placement: Strong continuous lower roof line extending slightly beyond both ends.
Very short terminal stroke at the far-right roof edge.

steps.name: chimney_body
steps.description: Draw the rectangular chimney rising vertically from the upper-left portion of the main roof.

elements.placement: Tall narrow front face of the chimney rising above the roof.
Narrow right face providing simple perspective depth.
Small quadrilateral top surface of the chimney.

steps.name: left_side_door
steps.description: Draw the narrow arched doorway on the left side wall.

elements.placement: Tall narrow doorway with a rounded arch at the top. Its bottom ends at the lower edge of the side wall.

steps.name: left_gable_window
steps.description: Draw the small narrow window in the triangular left gable wall.

elements.placement: Small vertical window following the perspective of the left wall.
Single vertical divider through the small gable window.

steps.name: front_left_window
steps.description: Draw the square four-pane window on the left half of the front wall.

elements.placement: Nearly square window aligned with the front wall perspective.
Vertical divider splitting the window into left and right panes.
Horizontal divider splitting the window into upper and lower panes.

steps.name: front_right_window
steps.description: Draw the second square four-pane window on the right half of the front wall.

elements.placement: Square window matching the left front window and following the slight wall perspective.
Vertical center divider.
Horizontal center divider.

steps.name: house_bottom_edges
steps.description: Emphasize the connected lower edges of the house so the side and front walls meet cleanly.

elements.placement: Diagonal lower edge of the left side wall.
Long slightly rising bottom edge of the front wall.
